source.title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
source.boundary: Source asserts logarithmic necessity but does not provide this lower-bound construction, finite-T constants or randomized policy specification. Candidate is independently derived support; source gaps remain explicit.

target.interface: For each seed probability law and seed-measurable strict-history policy valued pointwise in[0,1], each positiveT admits a fixed binary path outside the seed expectation with total squared-loss regret against the feasible empirical-mean comparator at least H(T+1)/6 and log(T+2)/6.
target.zeroHorizon: Excluded by terminal0<T; internal totalization remains explicit
target.semantics: No half loss factor; one witness may depend on law,policy,T; not pathwise,a.s.,singlepathforallpolicies,or sharpconstant claim

actualDeclarations.name: polyaNext
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def polyaNext (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  ((h.count true : ℝ) + 1) / ((h.length : ℝ) + 2)

actualDeclarations.name: pathWeight
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def pathWeight (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  match h with
  | [] => 1
  | b :: past => pathWeight past * (if b then polyaNext past else 1 - polyaNext past)

actualDeclarations.name: binaryStream
actualDeclarations.lean:
def binaryStream (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : Bool :=
  (h.reverse[t]?).getD false

actualDeclarations.name: binaryValues
actualDeclarations.lean:
def binaryValues (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if binaryStream h t then 1 else 0

actualDeclarations.name: causalPredict
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def causalPredict (A : List Bool → ℝ) (y : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  A (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin t => y i)).reverse

actualDeclarations.name: pathRegret
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def pathRegret (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - binaryValues h t)^2)
    (causalPredict A (binaryStream h)) (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length) h.length

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def pathExpectation (T : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v : List.Vector Bool T, pathWeight v.toList * f v.toList

actualDeclarations.name: prefixMeasure
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def prefixMeasure (T : ℕ) [MeasurableSpace (List.Vector Bool T)] :
    Measure (List.Vector Bool T) :=
  BanditRLProof.Exp3.finiteActionMeasure univ (fun v => pathWeight v.toList)

actualDeclarations.name: probability_mem
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem probability_mem (h : List Bool) :
    polyaNext h ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1

actualDeclarations.name: branch_mass
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem branch_mass (h : List Bool) :
    pathWeight (false :: h) + pathWeight (true :: h) = pathWeight h

actualDeclarations.name: pathWeight_nonneg
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathWeight_nonneg (h : List Bool) :
    0 ≤ pathWeight h

actualDeclarations.name: vectorConsEquiv
actualDeclarations.lean:
private def vectorConsEquiv (T : ℕ) :
    Bool × List.Vector Bool T ≃ List.Vector Bool (T + 1) where
  toFun p := p.1 ::ᵥ p.2
  invFun v := (v.head, v.tail)
  left_inv p := by cases p; simp
  right_inv v := List.Vector.cons_head_tail v

actualDeclarations.name: sum_vectors_succ
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem sum_vectors_succ (T : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    (∑ v : List.Vector Bool (T + 1), f v.toList) =
      ∑ v : List.Vector Bool T, (f (false :: v.toList) + f (true :: v.toList))

actualDeclarations.name: prefix_mass_one
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem prefix_mass_one (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ v : List.Vector Bool T, pathWeight v.toList) = 1

actualDeclarations.name: prefix_distribution
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem prefix_distribution (T : ℕ) :
    BanditRLProof.Exp3.FiniteActionDistribution (univ : Finset (List.Vector Bool T)) (fun v => pathWeight v.toList)

actualDeclarations.name: prefixMeasure_probability
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem prefixMeasure_probability (T : ℕ) [MeasurableSpace (List.Vector Bool T)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List.Vector Bool T)] :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (prefixMeasure T)

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_integral
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_integral (T : ℕ) [MeasurableSpace (List.Vector Bool T)] [MeasurableSingletonClass (List.Vector Bool T)] (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    (∫ v, f v.toList ∂prefixMeasure T) = pathExpectation T f

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_congr
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_congr (T : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ h, h.length = T → f h = g h) :
    pathExpectation T f = pathExpectation T g

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_const
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_const (T : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun _ => c) = c

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_add
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_add (T : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => f h + g h) = pathExpectation T f + pathExpectation T g

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_sub
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_sub (T : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => f h - g h) = pathExpectation T f - pathExpectation T g

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_const_mul
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_const_mul (T : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => c * f h) = c * pathExpectation T f

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_div
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_div (T : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => f h / c) = pathExpectation T f / c

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_succ
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_succ (T : ℕ) (f : List Bool → ℝ) :
    pathExpectation (T + 1) f = pathExpectation T
      (fun h => (1 - polyaNext h) * f (false :: h) + polyaNext h * f (true :: h))

actualDeclarations.name: heads_succ
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem heads_succ (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation (T + 1) (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) =
      pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) +
        (pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) + 1) / ((T : ℝ) + 2)

actualDeclarations.name: heads_sq_succ
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem heads_sq_succ (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation (T + 1) (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)^2) =
      pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)^2) +
        (2 * pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)^2) +
         3 * pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) + 1) / ((T : ℝ) + 2)

actualDeclarations.name: expected_heads
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_heads (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) = (T : ℝ) / 2

actualDeclarations.name: expected_heads_sq
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_heads_sq (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)^2) = (T : ℝ) * (2 * (T : ℝ) + 1) / 6

actualDeclarations.name: expected_next_variance
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_next_variance (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation T (fun h => polyaNext h * (1 - polyaNext h)) = ((T : ℝ) + 3) / (6 * ((T : ℝ) + 2))

actualDeclarations.name: causalPredict_prefix
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem causalPredict_prefix (A : List Bool → ℝ) (y z : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ) (hpast : ∀ i < t, y i = z i) :
    causalPredict A y t = causalPredict A z t

actualDeclarations.name: binary_mean_minimizer
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binary_mean_minimizer (h : List Bool) (hpos : 0 < h.length) :
    empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∑ t ∈ range h.length, (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length - binaryValues h t)^2) ≤ ∑ t ∈ range h.length, (u - binaryValues h t)^2

actualDeclarations.name: conditional_square_lower
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem conditional_square_lower (h : List Bool) (x : ℝ) :
    polyaNext h * (1 - polyaNext h) ≤ (1 - polyaNext h) * x^2 + polyaNext h * (x - 1)^2

actualDeclarations.name: binaryStream_cons_prefix
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binaryStream_cons_prefix (b : Bool) (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < h.length) :
    binaryStream (b :: h) t = binaryStream h t

actualDeclarations.name: binaryStream_cons_last
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binaryStream_cons_last (b : Bool) (h : List Bool) :
    binaryStream (b :: h) h.length = b

actualDeclarations.name: binaryValues_cons_prefix
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binaryValues_cons_prefix (b : Bool) (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < h.length) :
    binaryValues (b :: h) t = binaryValues h t

actualDeclarations.name: causalPredict_history
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem causalPredict_history (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) :
    causalPredict A (binaryStream h) h.length = A h

actualDeclarations.name: causalPredict_cons_last
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem causalPredict_cons_last (A : List Bool → ℝ) (b : Bool) (h : List Bool) :
    causalPredict A (binaryStream (b :: h)) h.length = A h

actualDeclarations.name: pathLearnerLoss
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def pathLearnerLoss (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ range h.length, (causalPredict A (binaryStream h) t - binaryValues h t)^2

actualDeclarations.name: pathBestLoss
actualDeclarations.lean:
noncomputable def pathBestLoss (h : List Bool) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ range h.length, (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length - binaryValues h t)^2

actualDeclarations.name: pathRegret_eq_losses
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathRegret_eq_losses (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool) :
    pathRegret A h = pathLearnerLoss A h - pathBestLoss h

actualDeclarations.name: pathLearnerLoss_cons
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathLearnerLoss_cons (A : List Bool → ℝ) (b : Bool) (h : List Bool) :
    pathLearnerLoss A (b :: h) = pathLearnerLoss A h + (A h - if b then 1 else 0)^2

actualDeclarations.name: binaryValues_sum
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binaryValues_sum (h : List Bool) :
    (∑ t ∈ range h.length, binaryValues h t) = (h.count true : ℝ)

actualDeclarations.name: binaryValues_sq
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem binaryValues_sq (h : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (binaryValues h t)^2 = binaryValues h t

actualDeclarations.name: pathBestLoss_count
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathBestLoss_count (h : List Bool) (hpos : 0 < h.length) :
    pathBestLoss h = (h.count true : ℝ) - (h.count true : ℝ)^2 / (h.length : ℝ)

actualDeclarations.name: expected_pathBestLoss
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_pathBestLoss (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    pathExpectation T pathBestLoss = ((T : ℝ) - 1) / 6

actualDeclarations.name: pathExpectation_mono
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathExpectation_mono (T : ℕ) (f g : List Bool → ℝ)
    (hfg : ∀ h, h.length = T → f h ≤ g h) :
    pathExpectation T f ≤ pathExpectation T g

actualDeclarations.name: expected_pathLearnerLoss_succ
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_pathLearnerLoss_succ (A : List Bool → ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation (T + 1) (pathLearnerLoss A) =
      pathExpectation T (pathLearnerLoss A) + pathExpectation T
        (fun h => (1 - polyaNext h) * (A h)^2 + polyaNext h * (A h - 1)^2)

actualDeclarations.name: expected_pathLearnerLoss_step
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_pathLearnerLoss_step (A : List Bool → ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    pathExpectation T (pathLearnerLoss A) + ((T : ℝ) + 3) / (6 * ((T : ℝ) + 2)) ≤
      pathExpectation (T + 1) (pathLearnerLoss A)

actualDeclarations.name: variance_sum
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem variance_sum (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((t : ℝ) + 3) / (6 * ((t : ℝ) + 2))) =
      (T : ℝ) / 6 + ((harmonic (T + 1) : ℝ) - 1) / 6

actualDeclarations.name: expected_pathLearnerLoss_lower
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_pathLearnerLoss_lower (A : List Bool → ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, ((t : ℝ) + 3) / (6 * ((t : ℝ) + 2))) ≤
      pathExpectation T (pathLearnerLoss A)

actualDeclarations.name: expected_pathRegret_lower
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem expected_pathRegret_lower (A : List Bool → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (harmonic (T + 1) : ℝ) / 6 ≤ pathExpectation T (pathRegret A)

actualDeclarations.name: pathWeight_pos
actualDeclarations.lean: theorem pathWeight_pos (h : List Bool) : 0 < pathWeight h

actualDeclarations.name: square_loss_mem
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem square_loss_mem (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hy : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (x - y)^2 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

actualDeclarations.name: square_loss_sum_mem
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem square_loss_sum_mem (T : ℕ) (p y : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ t < T, p t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hy : ∀ t < T, y t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (p t - y t)^2) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T

actualDeclarations.name: pathRegret_abs_le
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathRegret_abs_le (A : List Bool → ℝ) (h : List Bool)
    (hbound : ∀ k, A k ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : |pathRegret A h| ≤ (h.length : ℝ)

actualDeclarations.name: pathRegret_measurable
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathRegret_measurable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (A : Ω → List Bool → ℝ) (hA : ∀ h, Measurable (fun ω => A ω h)) (h : List Bool) :
    Measurable (fun ω => pathRegret (A ω) h)

actualDeclarations.name: pathRegret_integrable
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem pathRegret_integrable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Ω → List Bool → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ h, Measurable (fun ω => A ω h)) (hbound : ∀ ω h, A ω h ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (h : List Bool) : Integrable (fun ω => pathRegret (A ω) h) μ

actualDeclarations.name: randomized_harmonic_lower
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem randomized_harmonic_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Ω → List Bool → ℝ) (hA : ∀ h, Measurable (fun ω => A ω h)) (hbound : ∀ ω h, A ω h ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ v : List.Vector Bool T, (harmonic (T + 1) : ℝ) / 6 ≤ ∫ ω, pathRegret (A ω) v.toList ∂μ

actualDeclarations.name: randomized_log_lower
actualDeclarations.lean:
theorem randomized_log_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Ω → List Bool → ℝ) (hA : ∀ h, Measurable (fun ω => A ω h)) (hbound : ∀ ω h, A ω h ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ v : List.Vector Bool T, Real.log ((T : ℝ) + 2) / 6 ≤ ∫ ω, pathRegret (A ω) v.toList ∂μ
